subject: Limited access request: penetration report access protocol, NDA & redaction clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Geller <alex.geller@acme-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2025-11-02 09:12 -0700
Subject: Request: penetration test report access and NDA

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 walkthrough last week — the engineering team appreciated the detail. As part of our final review we'd like to review the penetration test report and the high-level executive summary that was performed in September. Our security team requires: a) an NDA covering the report, b) an explanation of the portions that will be redacted (if any), and c) a suggested secure access mechanism (time-limited link, secure viewer, watermarked PDF).

Can you share the process your security team prefers for limited report access and whether Redwood is open to allowing an in-person/secure-view-only review for particularly sensitive evidence? Also, if possible, please attach an exec summary under limited sharing while we sort the NDA.

Best,
Alex Geller
Senior InfoSec Manager, Acme Analytics
---
Note: security@acme-analytics.com is monitoring for compliance approvals.

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03 10:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report access and NDA

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can accommodate a limited-access exchange. Proposed approach from Redwood: 

- Step 1 (Immediate): Provide a redacted executive summary PDF under a Mutual NDA (we can use a slim NDA for review discussions). Attachment: Exec_Summary_v1.pdf (watermarked).
- Step 2 (Legal): Execute a two-way NDA or an addendum to your existing terms; our legal team typically proposes a paragraph limiting distribution and requiring secure handling.
- Step 3 (Secure Review Options): For full report review we offer two options: (A) time-limited secure viewer (browser-based, disabled download, visible tracking) for up to 7 days; (B) on-site secure room review for enterprise customers with sensitive evidence.
- Step 4 (Redaction): We will produce a redaction matrix showing which low-level evidence items (IP addresses, third-party customer identifiers) would be redacted for external sharing. See attached Redaction_Matrix_v0.2.xlsx.

Two clarifications we need from you:
1) Do you need the full tool output (raw logs) or only the report narrative + evidence excerpts?
2) Will your legal team accept our standard limited-distribution clause, or do you want to propose edits?

If that works I’ll loop in Legal and Security for a quick turnaround — target is NDA executed and exec summary shared within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

----
Attachment stubs: Exec_Summary_v1.pdf (watermarked), Redaction_Matrix_v0.2.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@acme-analytics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, security@acme-analytics.com
Date: 2025-11-04 08:17 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report access and NDA

Alex/Diego —

Quick note from Legal: we're happy to start with our mutual NDA template and accept a short set of carve-outs for procurement review. I attached a redline (Legal_NDA_Redline_vACME.docx) with three suggested tweaks: (1) Narrow the permitted reviewers to named employees and external counsel; (2) Limit the timeline for the secure viewer to 7 days with a logging requirement; (3) Explicitly permit redaction of third-party identifiers.

If Acme prefers to sign your template, please send it and we will mark it up. Once NDA is in place we will: (a) publish the exec summary link in the secure viewer, (b) provide the redaction matrix, and (c) schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our lead security engineer.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: RedTeam PenTest <reports@redteam.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Alex Geller <alex.geller@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2025-11-06 11:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report access and NDA

Diego/Alex —

We are copied for coordination. Per our contract with Redwood we can provide the full technical report to Acme under a scoped NDA and with agreed redactions. Note: some evidence items reference third-party scopes that require additional approvals. We will wait for the executed NDA before packaging the deliverables.

Alex — we prepared a suggested counterproposal that relaxes the download restriction for named Acme reviewers; see the DocuSign packet here: https://docusign.com/pack/ACME-PT-NDA-4567. If you sign, we will upload the watermarked exec summary to the secure viewer and share access logs.

—RedTeam Ops

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Alex Geller <alex.geller@acme-analytics.com>, reports@redteam.io
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-07 16:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: penetration test report access and NDA

Alex — thanks. To keep momentum:

1) Please have Acme sign the DocuSign packet (link above). If you prefer to send Acme’s own NDA instead, we’ll review but that will add ~24-48 hours.
2) Once the NDA is executed we will: a) grant time-limited secure-viewer access (7 days) to the two named reviewers you provide, b) upload Exec_Summary_v1.pdf (watermarked) to the viewer, and c) deliver the Redaction_Matrix_v0.2.xlsx showing the planned redactions for the full technical report.
3) Proposed schedule: NDA signed by EOD Thursday (11/13), secure-viewer access granted by 11/14, 30-minute walkthrough scheduled for week of 11/17. Please confirm reviewers and preferred walkthrough slots.

If you need an in-person review instead, we can coordinate a secure room but that requires more lead time.

Diego
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

----
Delivery notes: Link to secure exec summary will be posted to our restricted Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/pt/Acme-2025/Exec_Summary_v1.
